name: Boss Courts

bosses.name: Ashwing
bosses.strategy: Two half-base-HP lives. No on-hit fire. Cinders every third round; low-life Dive exposes the boss.
bosses.mechanics:
两条各 48% 基础血量的生命
每三轮烧一件装备，W1 为 5 点
低血扑击 18 点，随后自身易伤
bosses.counter: 留资源应对第二条生命；避免急用燃烧装备，利用扑击后的易伤反攻。

bosses.name: Old Thorn
bosses.strategy: EVEN rounds: one Thorn Reprisal, 10% of own missing life, capped at [MBD*0.11]. ODD rounds: no reprisal. No 50% CounterAttack status.
bosses.mechanics:
偶数轮一次荆棘反攻：自身已损失血量的 10%
伤害上限 MBD×11%，W2 为 8 点，可格挡
奇数轮不反击；低血治疗最多两次
bosses.counter: 奇数轮集中输出；偶数轮用护盾挡住反攻。多次小伤害不会触发多次反击。

bosses.name: Three Kings
bosses.strategy: All three heads are active at any life. K/Q/J share the same hand; each head has Cooldown 1. Jack exposes the boss.
bosses.mechanics:
三头均可行动，K/Q/J 共用手牌
每个头冷却一轮，降低单头系数
J 雷击后自身易伤
bosses.counter: 观察三种王牌，优先换走关键牌；利用各头冷却和雷击后的易伤。

bosses.name: River Serpent
bosses.strategy: Tide Block every other round. Devour on rounds 5/10/15; no Undertow on the following round.
bosses.mechanics:
每两轮获得少量护盾
第五轮吞噬，第六轮停攻
吞噬后自身易伤
bosses.counter: 护盾量随进度缩放；第五轮先防御，下一轮利用停攻和易伤输出。

bosses.name: Thunder Giant
bosses.strategy: Storm Pact supplies ONE shared full-power lightning strike every other round; no mutual damage.
bosses.mechanics:
每两轮补充 Ionize 1
三红牌雷击，黑牌防御
双方争夺满功率雷击
bosses.counter: 有雷击装备可抢先消耗共享机会；也可换走红牌，让它花牌防御。

bosses.name: Black Sail
bosses.strategy: Pairs Hex ONE item and return the boss cards. No Stun. Broadside makes the boss Weak 2.
bosses.mechanics:
对子 Hex 一件装备并返牌
不再弃掉玩家全部手牌
炮击后自身虚弱两轮
bosses.counter: 对子会返还给黑帆继续行动；趁 Hex 冷却或炮击后的虚弱窗口交换伤害。

bosses.name: Storm Sovereign
bosses.strategy: Five-round cycle: rest / ramp / ramp / telegraph / burst. Ramp is capped; first round is safe.
bosses.mechanics:
第二、三轮：攻击逐次增强
第四轮蓄势，第五轮重击
第六轮停攻；强化有上限
bosses.counter: 第 4/9/14 轮备防御；重击后的下一轮集中输出，不宜无限拖延。

bosses.name: Crowned Titan
bosses.strategy: Every hit draws one card. Four-card Straight causes a heavy attack and Vulnerable; Ward stops below 40% life.
bosses.mechanics:
每次受击立即抽一张牌
四连顺重击后自身易伤
低血后护盾关闭
bosses.counter: 减少低伤连击，别帮它凑出四连顺；低血时失去护盾，可集中结束战斗。

bosses.name: Underqueen
bosses.strategy: Hex on rounds 1/5/9; Freeze on 3/7/11. They never coincide; even rounds have only card-based attack.
bosses.mechanics:
1/5/9 轮：Hex 一件
3/7/11 轮：冻结一件
偶数轮只有牌型攻击
bosses.counter: 控制严格错开；留小牌解冻、准备备用装备，在偶数轮集中使用关键装备。

bosses.name: Azure Dragon
bosses.strategy: 12-round cycle: Ice 1-3 / rest 4 / Storm 5-7 / rest 8 / Fire 9-11 / rest 12. Repeat.
bosses.mechanics:
冰 1–3、雷 5–7、火 9–11
每段之间一轮停攻
循环重复，三个阶段可控
bosses.counter: 冰段留解冻牌，雷段抢 Ionize，火段调整装备使用；4/8/12 轮是输出窗口。

bosses.name: The Reassembled
bosses.strategy: Above 50%: stitched attacks. At 50% or less: rage; Slam every fourth round, followed by no attacks. No revival.
bosses.mechanics:
半血前：缝合与小额毒伤
半血后：高伤拳击与重击
重击下一轮停攻，无复活
bosses.counter: 半血前准备爆发；跨血线后注意四轮重击周期，在停攻轮反击。

bosses.name: Queen of Clubs
bosses.strategy: Uses HER OWN Clubs: two for Gambit, one for Guard. Hearts heal twice only; player draws never trigger punishment.
bosses.mechanics:
两梅花豪赌后自身易伤
同一批梅花也用于防御
红心治疗，仅两次
bosses.counter: 观察王后自己的梅花和红心；两梅花爆发后利用易伤，治疗有明确上限。

bosses.name: Obsidian Smith
bosses.strategy: Six-round forge cycle: rest 1-2 / forge 3-4 / telegraph 5 / hammer 6. Hammer exposes the smith.
bosses.mechanics:
3/4 轮：锻造护盾与攻击
第 5 轮预告，第 6 轮砸锤
1/2 轮停炉，循环重复
bosses.counter: 第 5/11/17 轮准备防御；重击后有两轮停炉，集中输出，避免护盾累积。
